title: Release quest-cli 0.7.1: unpaired hotfix carrying the stranded-"Blocked" repair
description: Ruled by opum-agent 2026-09-15 15:35Z: QCLI-302 ships as 0.7.1 ahead of everything else, because every fleet workspace that paused anything before 0.7.0 holds a record no command can move (LWEB-80, LCLI-333 known; LCLI-333 makes lore check exit 6 on lore-cli dev). This release breaks the quest/lore version lockstep deliberately, as 0.6.2 did: lore stays at 0.7.0 and nothing in lore changes. Scope is the bump, the CI-built binaries, the tag, and the publish -- the fix itself is QCLI-302 and must be on dev before this starts. Follow docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, in particular "What a version bump touches" (strings first, then bytes, two commits) and the consumer-side visibility gate QCLI-299 added to scripts/publish-release.mjs. Trusted publishing is still broken (QCLI-271), so the publish goes through the local script under the repository owner direct authorization; that step is tier 3 and never moves on relayed instruction.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version bumped to 0.7.1 across every hand-edited location (package.json .version and its six optionalDependencies pins, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture questVersion, .claude-plugin/plugin.json) and all six platform packages rebuilt via a CI dispatch of prepublication-qualification.yml against the release branch, with check:packages and test:packages green, landed as dev-only prep
bun.lock regenerated so its platform-package pins match 0.7.1 and bun install --frozen-lockfile passes in CI
CLAUDE.md managed Quest block regenerated against the freshly built local binary, not the globally installed CLI, and Tracker integrity green on the bump PR
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased heading moved to 0.7.1 with the date in the bump PR, stating that this release is unpaired with lore (which stays 0.7.0) and why

dev promoted to main via the fast-forward sequence once the bump PR is green, v0.7.1 tagged on that SHA, prepublication-qualification dispatched on the tag, and the publish run through scripts/publish-release.mjs under the owner direct authorization; the wrapper and all six platform packages resolve at 0.7.1 from the public registry with no credential; lore-cli and lore-web told with the repair command

plan: Stage one, strings: bump the six hand-edited sites to 0.7.1, bun install to regenerate bun.lock, regenerate the CLAUDE.md managed block from the source build, move CHANGELOG Unreleased to 0.7.1 (unpaired, lore stays 0.7.0); commit; open the PR; let source-gates go green.

Stage two, bytes: dispatch prepublication-qualification.yml against the release branch, download the candidate bundle, install the six CI-built binaries and their manifests, check:packages and test:packages green; commit; checks green; squash into dev.
Promote dev to main by fast-forward; tag v0.7.1 on that SHA; dispatch qualification on the tag; receipt:require.
Publish: owner authorization (tier 3, direct); scripts/publish-release.mjs; receipt:verify-published; npm view resolves 0.7.1 for the wrapper and all six platforms from a credential-free read.
Tell lore-cli and lore-web with the repair command; close QCLI-302 AC5 and this task.
implementationNotes:
STAGE ONE AND TWO ON THE BRANCH, 2026-09-15, PR #124 (chore/QCLI-303-release-0.7.1).

STAGE ONE, commit 73d2fe6: six hand-edited sites plus each platform manifest .version to 0.7.1; bun.lock regenerated; CHANGELOG Unreleased -> 0.7.1 dated 2026-09-15 with the deliberate lockstep break stated (lore stays 0.7.0); CLAUDE.md managed block regenerated from the source build (bun run src/cli/main.ts agents --update-instructions --target claude, which reports 0.7.1). agents --check against the source build read state version-only before regeneration, exit 0 by design, which is why the step is manual. check:packages exit 0 in the strings-only state, verified. bun run check 506/506.

STAGE TWO, commit e3d2732: qualification run 34987686680 (workflow_dispatch against 73d2fe6) green on source-gates, all six immutable-candidates jobs and candidate-bundle. All six quest-package-<target> artifacts downloaded; sha256 recomputed over each downloaded binary and compared to that artifact own questBinarySha256 before installing: six of six agree. Digests: darwin-arm64 0710444a..., darwin-x64 b313d5d4..., linux-arm64 e4638279..., linux-x64 caef7c10..., win32-arm64 9ce01aea..., win32-x64 37a51000... (full values in package.json questPlatformPackages). check:packages and test:packages exit 0. The darwin-arm64 binary was never executed from the working tree and was deleted and recreated from the untouched download as the last action before git, per the runbook SIGKILL hazard.

The install procedure is a script this time (scratchpad install-candidates.sh: download, verify, install, rewrite the digest map), not hand steps; worth promoting into scripts/ under a follow-up rather than re-typing next bump.

PR #124 LANDED on dev by squash. Gate evidence on its head e3d2732, read by check name rather than the rollup: source-gates x2 (pull_request plus the path-filtered push trigger), Tracker integrity, lore check, all success; bun install --frozen-lockfile passed inside each of them, which is AC2 evidence. The six native-execution jobs (macos-14 arm64, macos-15 x64, ubuntu-24.04 arm64/x64, windows-11 arm64, windows-2022 x64) all success: they execute the newly installed binaries on real hardware, so the six artifacts are not merely byte-identical to what CI hashed, they run. AC1-AC3 checked on that.

PROMOTION, TAG, QUALIFICATION, PUBLISH, all 2026-09-15.
- main: f027c24 -> 9258018 by `git push origin origin/dev:main` after PR #125 ran the required checks on that SHA (source-gates, Tracker integrity green; promotion-is-manual red by design). Asserted through the refs API after the push: main == origin/dev. PR #125 auto-marked MERGED, no merge commit.
- Tag v0.7.1 -> 9258018 (lightweight, unlike the annotated 0.6.x tags; functionally equivalent for quest-web link gate, noted for the record). Qualification dispatched against the tag: run 34990618714, source-gates, six platform jobs, candidate-bundle and native-execution-receipt all success. receipt:require from the 9258018 checkout: "binds 0.7.1 at 9258018 across all six platforms" (it correctly refused from the closure branch one commit past the tag first).
- Publish: owner authorized directly via AskUserQuestion; scripts/publish-release.mjs --publish with the keychain token; six platform packages published, the QCLI-299 gate saw all six resolve for a consumer, held 30s, re-read, then published the wrapper; exit 0.
- Consumer-side evidence, independent of the script: plain HTTPS reads of registry.npmjs.org resolve all six platform packages and the wrapper at 0.7.1; dist-tags latest 0.7.1; receipt:verify-published matches every platform tarball; npm install -g @opum-ai/quest@0.7.1 succeeded and the installed binary ran the repair end to end on a hand-stranded record; quest agents --check --require-installed reads current.
- One finding, filed as QCLI-304: the wrapper first resolved from a plain read at 16:04:06Z, about a minute after the script printed "published and verified"; an install attempt inside that minute failed with notarget. Not staged this time, and nothing was uninstallable for longer than that minute.
- lore-cli and lore-web sent the install and repair commands.
finalSummary:
quest-cli 0.7.1 is published, installable, and on main; it is the unpaired hotfix carrying QCLI-302 (lore stays 0.7.0, stated in the CHANGELOG header as 0.6.2 did).

WHAT SHIPPED AND HOW. Strings first, bytes second, per the runbook: PR #124 (squash 9258018) moved the six hand-edited version sites plus each platform manifest to 0.7.1, regenerated bun.lock, moved CHANGELOG Unreleased to 0.7.1 dated 2026-09-15, regenerated the CLAUDE.md managed block from the source build; then installed the six binaries built by qualification run 34987686680, each artifact questBinarySha256 recomputed over the downloaded bytes before install (six of six agree), questPlatformPackages updated to the same digests, check:packages and test:packages green, six native-execution jobs green on the PR. dev fast-forwarded to main (asserted via API), v0.7.1 tagged on 9258018, qualification on the tag (run 34990618714) green with a native-execution receipt that receipt:require accepted at that checkout, publish through scripts/publish-release.mjs under the owner direct authorization with the consumer-side visibility gate from QCLI-299 in force.

EVIDENCE THE RELEASE IS REAL, read independently of the publisher: wrapper and all six platform packages resolve at 0.7.1 from plain HTTPS with no credential, latest tag 0.7.1, receipt:verify-published matches the published bytes, a clean global install of 0.7.1 ran the QCLI-302 repair end to end. lore-cli and lore-web told.

WORTH KEEPING. The stage-two install is now a script (download, verify, install, rewrite the digest map) rather than hand steps; promote it into scripts/ before the next bump. The wrapper verification message preceded consumer visibility by about a minute (QCLI-304). The darwin-arm64 binary was never executed from the working tree, which is what kept git alive.
